question: Hariprasad Chaurasia is a ______ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flute**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hariprasad Chaurasia was born on 1 July 1938. He is an Indian music director and classical flautist, who plays the Bansuri in the Hindustani classical tradition.
 
• He was born in Pryagraj, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The 2013 documentary film Bansuri Guru features the life and legacy of Chaurasia.
 
• He won Gansamradni Lata Mangeshkar Award - 2021-22, Padma Bhushan(1992), Padma Vibhushan(2000) etc.
 
• Official Biography 'Breath of Gold' by Sathya Saran- 2019 and 'Bansuri Samrat: Hariprasad Chaurasia' by Surjit Singh are some of the biographies of Chaurasia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some major albums released by Hariprasad Chaurasia:

 
 
• Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia - Flute, 1981.
 
• Morning to Midnight Ragas - Morning Ragas, 1987.
 
• Call of the Valley, 1988.
 
• Flute Deity Hariprasad Chaurasia and Sounds of Silence, 2003.
 
• Ajanma - Hariprasad Chaurasia, 2015.
